description:
Our 12 Pro balance bike just got even better! Known internationally for introducing independence, power, and responsibility to millions of kids at an early age, this exclusive collection includes upgraded gear on our 12 Pro frame to inspire even more confidence for riders who are getting bigger and faster.

Each special combination includes a special Strider 12 Pro frame in colors you can’t get anywhere else, two anodized High-Traction Wheels, an eye-catching anodized Aluminum Flat Handlebar, and comfortable kid-fit Mini Grips.

The 12 Pro frame gives riders and ultra-light ride with an aluminum frame and includes our innovative Standing Footrest — the #1 balance bike feature that teaches kids how to stand on their bike and master advanced riding skills that they’ll use on bigger bikes or (someday) motorcycles!

Made for speed demons who are big enough and fast enough to really fly on their Strider, the High-Traction Wheels have an all-surface tread for maximum grip no matter the terrain, and the pneumatic tires give your rider some cushion for a smooth riding experience.

The Aluminum Flat Handlebar puts your little ripper in the ideal racing position, gives them some extra swagger in their step, and helps them steer around tricky corners with comfort and control.

Explore these limited-edition combinations to find a bike that brings out their inner superhero and makes them fly on two wheels.

Not seeing the bike of your kiddo’s dreams here? Choose from a variety of fun-colored wheels, grips, handlebars, and frames in our Bike Builder!
